contents.subject: Anglais
contents.description: Diagnostic Anglais 1ere : Formation des mots – préfixes et suffixes

questions.question: What does the prefix 'mis-' mean in the word 'misunderstand'?
The suffix '-less' added to a noun creates an adjective meaning 'without something'.
Forme le nom correspondant au verbe 'develop' en ajoutant le bon suffixe. Utilise-le dans une phrase.
Choose the correct word formation: The adjective form of 'danger' is:
The prefix 'over-' in 'overestimate' means the action was done too much or beyond normal.
Transforme l'adjectif 'happy' en nom et en adverbe à l'aide de suffixes appropriés.
Which word is formed correctly using the prefix 're-'?
The suffix '-able' in 'comfortable' and 'reliable' creates adjectives meaning 'can be done' or 'worthy of'.

exercisenotion.description: Les préfixes modifient le sens d'un mot : un- (not: unhappy), re- (again: redo), pre- (before: preview), dis- (not/opposite: disagree), over- (too much: overwork), under- (too little: underestimate), mis- (wrongly: misunderstand), inter- (between: international).

Les suffixes transforment la catégorie grammaticale. Suffixes nominaux : -tion/-sion (action→ation), -ness (happy→happiness), -ment (develop→development), -er/-or (teach→teacher), -ity (equal→equality). Suffixes adjectivaux : -ful (hope→hopeful), -less (hope→hopeless), -ous (danger→dangerous), -able/-ible (comfort→comfortable).

Suffixes verbaux : -ize/-ise (modern→modernize), -en (short→shorten), -ify (simple→simplify). Suffixe adverbial principal : -ly (quick→quickly, careful→carefully). Attention aux irrégularités : good→well, fast→fast, hard→hard.
